# Rotaract South Asia MDIO (RSAMDIO)

> Rotaract South Asia MDIO is a regional group of member districts formed to disseminate information and facilitate communication among Rotaract clubs across 8 nations in South Asia, and to support leadership learning and multidistrict programs.

RSAMDIO is Rotary International's recognized Multi-District Information Organization for Rotaract in South Asia, covering Rotary Zones 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8. It serves Rotaract clubs and member districts and does not govern them.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://rsamdio.org): Regional hub for Rotaract across South Asia.
- [About](https://rsamdio.org/about): Organizational background, purpose, history, and FAQs.
- [Leadership](https://rsamdio.org/leadership): Executive Board, District Rotaract Representatives (DRRs), and Committee members.
- [Member Districts](https://rsamdio.org/districts): Directory of member districts, clubs, membership statistics, and leadership contacts.
- [Initiatives](https://rsamdio.org/initiatives): Digital ecosystem platforms and multidistrict service programs and campaigns.
- [Events](https://rsamdio.org/events): Signature conventions, regional gatherings, leadership learning sessions, and calendar.
- [News & Updates](https://rsamdio.org/news): Stories of community impact, official Secretariat announcements, and RSA Chronicles.
- [RSA Chronicles](https://rsamdio.org/chronicles): Official quarterly newsletter archive and publication series.
- [Presidents](https://rsamdio.org/presidents): Historical registry of past presidents of Rotaract South Asia MDIO.
- [Contact](https://rsamdio.org/contact): Secretariat contact details and regional coordination inquiries.

## Digital Ecosystem Platforms

- [Rotaract Library](https://library.rsamdio.org): Curated repository of official documents, templates, guidelines, and brand assets.
- [Invoice Calculator](https://dues.rsamdio.org): Rotary International January dues estimator with currency and tax calculations.
- [Publications Hub](https://publications.rsamdio.org): Digital reading space for publications and magazines from districts across South Asia.
- [Club Finder](https://clubs.rsamdio.org): Interactive map to search and discover Rotaract clubs across South Asia.
- [NAVIGATE](https://navigate.rsamdio.org): Interactive step-by-step guides for MyRotary, club administration, and officer workflows.
- [Rotaract Certify](https://certify.rsamdio.org): Digital certificate issuance and credential verification system.
- [PULSE](https://pulse.rsamdio.org): Real-time collaborative rooms for virtual sessions, district discussions, and events.

## Optional

- [Full Reference Documentation](https://rsamdio.org/llms-full.txt): Complete reference containing organization overview, member districts, leadership, and digital tools.
